portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Hot inflation prints (CPI 3.7% y/y, PPI 6.3% y/y), a 10-year near 5.09%, and a hiking Fed drove a sharp one-week rotation out of mega-cap tech and momentum into defensives, value and equal weight (RSP beat SPY by 2.46% in 5 sessions). Active-return dispersion of 4.27% is elevated. Tech-heavy groups with strong prior 16-session trends (semis, cyber, software) took 8%+ hits in one week with no in-briefing fundamental catalyst, which looks like a factor-crowding unwind rather than earnings deterioration; a partial mean reversion over one week is plausible but rates remain a headwind. Oil and staples strength lacks fresh catalysts inside the window.
